3. **Non-Negativity**: All shipments must be non-negative.

        # "the amount of resources shipped on any route cannot exceed the maximum capacity for that route"
        return (0, arcs[(i, j)][1])

    # "All shipments must be non-negative." / assumption: variable_domain NonNegativeReals

        model.arcs,
        within=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
        bounds=_bounds,
    )

        return arcs[(i, j)][0]

    # "minimizing the total transportation cost" / "sum of cost[i,j] * x[i,j] in raw cost units"
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(
        expr=sum(_cost(model, i, j) * model.x[i, j] for (i, j) in arcs),
        sense=pyo.minimize,
    )

    def _balance_rule(m, k):
        # "inflow - outflow == demand[i] (positive demand = net consumer)"
        inflow = sum(m.x[i, j] for (i, j) in arcs if j == k)
        outflow = sum(m.x[i, j] for (i, j) in arcs if i == k)
        return inflow - outflow == demand[k]

    # "the total flow of resources into and out of each city must balance according to their respective requirements"
    # assumption: enforce balance on all 9 cities (one is redundant)
    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.cities, rule=_balance_rule)

    return model

        return outflow - inflow == d["demand"][i]

    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.I, rule=_balance_rule)

    # Explicit capacity constraint x[i,j] <= capacity.
    # "the amount of resources shipped on any route cannot exceed the maximum capacity for that route"
    def _cap_rule(m, i, j):
        return m.x[i, j] <= d["arcs"][(i, j)][1]

    model.capacity = pyo.Constraint(model.A, rule=_cap_rule)

    return model
